verdicts.reason: Both candidates are effectively the same broken layout. The colourful geometric background is almost entirely gone, leaving a plain white banner with only a small striped fragment under the text. The white frame shrinks to an empty box floating on the right, and the pink dots drift off to the far canvas edges. 'DEAN COOPER' now sits above 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS', so the reading order is reversed. 'THE MINIMALIST' and the opening date are crammed onto one tiny line, and the left third is dead space. B is shifted a few pixels left and its text is very slightly smaller, but otherwise they are identical.
